stageNotes: Stage 1: apex 200, www->apex 301 redirect, <link rel=canonical>=apex. Canonical = https://alsimmonsgunshop.com.

Stage 2: 8-batch probe. cf-ray on every response. All real-traffic batches 200. Rapid burst (10 sequential): all 200. SQLi/XSS payloads: 200. Honeypots /wp-admin/wp-login redirect to login (WP-native, not CF). Bot UA python-requests 403 from PHP (origin). No body markers for MalCare/Wordfence/sgcaptcha/Incapsula. hasWaf=false; cloudflare-passive recorded informationally.
Stage 3: meta generator=WooCommerce 10.7.0, WordPress 6.9.4. Storefront theme. wc/store/v1/products and wp/v2/product both 200. platform=woocommerce, adapter=woocommerce, needsPlaywright=false.

Stage 4: taxonomy API returned 9 categories (7 top-level + 1 child + uncategorized). Per-category in-stock counts: 11+0+65+0+85+0+3 = 164 (~3 overlap with consignment child). /shop shows 'of 161 results' covering 100%. catalogUrls = ['/shop/'] is the minimum-cover set. topLevelCategories.categories documents the per-category breakdown for operator reference.
Stage 4g: 3 random extraction samples from /shop p1 all yielded title+url+price+stock_status via wc/store/v1 API. Confirmed real products.

Stage 5: Pagination /shop/page/2/. Zero overlap p1 vs p2 (both 9 unique products). perPage HTML=9 (Storefront default; ?perpage=99 ignored). API per_page caps at 100 (per_page=200 returns 400). Runtime uses HTML perPage=9.

Stage 6: <select name=orderby> options: popularity, date, price, price-desc. Default 'Sorted by latest' (data-is-sorted-by=true). 3-outcome counter-control: default==orderby=date (both Henry/CZ/Winchester); orderby=price returns Mossberg/Marlin/Colt. Verdict: honored-default-is-newest. sortParam=?orderby=date, sortVerified=true.

Stage 7: Method A two-probe: wp/v2/product ?after=2099-01-01 -> x-wp-total=0; ?after=1999-01-01 -> x-wp-total=1661. wc/store/v1 similar (0 / 161). Date filter monotonic. crawlers.watermark.method=api-date-since-watermark.

Stage 8: expectedProductCount=161 (customer-visible, what /shop and store-api in-stock return). Note: wp/v2 admin REST shows 1661 (includes 1500 OOS / sold consignment hidden from /shop). For alert purposes use 161 to avoid false back-in-stock on sold listings. productCountMethod = wp-rest-header on /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products.
